landing.title: Digitize, Manage & Optimize
landing.intro: Outlines fields using Leaflet maps, tracks soil conditions, schedules crop timeline tasks, and calculates input expenses on a unified dashboard tailored for farmers.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need To Grow Better
landing.featuresSubtitle: Advanced utility tools packaged in a simple, easy-to-use application.
landing.mappingText: Outline boundaries on interactive maps. We automatically compute accurate field acreage and center coordinates.
landing.weatherText: Localized weather alerts, hourly wind speeds, soil moisture levels, and solar coordinates tracking for your exact village.
landing.timelineText: Step-by-step guidance through sowing, vegetative growth, flowering, and maturity. Log observations and upload field photos.
landing.expenseText: Record machine rents, fertilizer purchases, seed costs, and labor hire. Stay on top of crop production budgets.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to digitize your farming operations?
landing.ctaText: Create your profile in 30 seconds. No credit cards, no complex setups. Just simple, practical tools designed for real farmers.
